title: There’s A Kind Of Failure Called Short-Sightedness
simplified_paragraphs: 公司来了两个实习生，我是他们的主管。有一天，吃完午饭后，我看见他们中的一个正在玩手机。我走过去问她：“我这正好有一份文件要翻译，你有时间帮忙完成一下吗？这份文件不在她的工作量里面，不过我看她似乎有空，就打算让她锻炼一下。她回答：“有啊，可是我只是个实习生啊。”我当时突然不知道说什么好，愣了一下，说：“是的。”然后就离开了。
我觉得这个实习生很“短视”。没错，她现在只是个实习生，工资很低，而且她已经完成了自己的工作。但是，她可能因此错过了一个更好的未来。
traditional_paragraphs: 公司來了兩個實習生，我是他們的主管。有一天，吃完午飯後，我看見他們中的一個正在玩手機。我走過去問她：“我這正好有一份文件要翻譯，你有時間幫忙完成一下嗎？這份文件不在她的工作量裡面，不過我看她似乎有空，就打算讓她鍛鍊一下。她回答：“有啊，可是我只是個實習生啊。”我當時突然不知道說什麼好，愣了一下，說：“是的。”然後就離開了。
我覺得這個實習生很“短視”。沒錯，她現在只是個實習生，工資很低，而且她已經完成了自己的工作。但是，她可能因此錯過了一個更好的未來。

wǒ jué de zhè ge shí xí shēng hěn“ duǎn shì”。 méi cuò， tā xiàn zài zhǐ shì gè shí xí shēng， gōng zī hěn dī， ér qiě tā yǐ jīng wán chéng le zì jǐ de gōng zuò。 dàn shì， tā kě néng yīn cǐ cuò guò le yī gè gèng hǎo de wèi lái。
english_paragraphs: Two interns joined the company, and I was their supervisor. One day after lunch, I saw one of them playing on her phone. I went over and asked, “I have a document that needs translating. Do you have time to help with it?” The document wasn’t part of her assigned work, but she seemed to have some free time, so I thought it would be a chance for her to practice. She replied, “I do, but I’m just an intern.” For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. I paused, said, “Yes, you are,” and walked away.

I think this intern was short-sighted. It’s true that she was only an intern, her pay was low, and she had already finished her own work. But because of that response, she may have missed out on a better future.

Do you have time to help with it?” The document wasn’t part of her assigned work, but she seemed to have some free time, so I thought it would be a chance for her to practice. She replied, “I do, but I’m just an intern.” For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. I paused, said, “Yes, you are,” and walked away.

I think this intern was short-sighted. It’s true that she was only an intern, her pay was low, and she had already finished her own work. But because of that response, she may have missed out on a better future.
